pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, dark-brown polygonal regions characterized by sharp pixel gradients at the boundaries with high-frequency serrated edges. Spatial area of individual patches is greatest on the upper-mid flank, decreasing significantly toward the lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous reticulated network of light-cream negative space. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial (Y-shaped). The pathways maintain a relatively uniform pixel thickness across the visible lateral surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, dark mane along the dorsal midline of the neck and shoulder displaying a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette against the sky background.
